briefdescription.para: Thread-safe diagnostic emitter for the distributed_knowledge module.

detaileddescription.para: Provides structured, machine-parseable event emission for federation incidents, merge failures, dedup collisions, and trust-gate violations.

sect2.title: Listener pattern
sect2.para: Register one or more IDKDiagnosticListener implementations to receive DKDiagnosticEvent structs. Listeners are called in registration order under the emitter's internal mutex; a throwing listener does not prevent the remaining listeners from being invoked.

sect2.title: JSON output contract
sect2.para: Each event serialises to a flat JSON object. The key names are stable across patch releases; new optional fields may be added without a version bump.
